text: dsh-bridge 是一款为 DSH 提供同一主机内会话通信的插件，通过三个工具接入 agent：session_list 列出可通信的活动会话，session_send 可按会话 ID 或标题发送消息，session_messages 查看当前会话收到的近期消息。它能解析在线和已保存会话、恢复离线目标，并对并发恢复与重复消息 ID 做处理；还提供供本地服务和可信传输调用的消息接口。适合在一个 DSH 主机内协调多个会话，或供聊天传输插件复用本地投递。近期记录和去重表保存在内存中，重载后清空；无需额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-bridge adds same-host messaging to DSH with tools to list active sessions, send messages by ID or title, and read recent deliveries. It can resume saved sessions and provides a delivery service for local integrations. Recent message history remains in memory and clears when the plugin reloads.
想查看当前 DSH 主机里有哪些可联系的会话。
能不能通过会话标题给另一个 agent 发消息？
让一个 DSH 会话把消息送到另一个会话。
我想翻看当前对话收到的最近几条内部消息。
How can I message another conversation by its readable title?
I need to see which live sessions can receive a message on this host.
Can an integration deliver a message into a persisted session and resume it first?
I want to read the latest messages addressed to my current DSH session.
dsh-bridge 的功能「会话发现」：通过 session_list 列出当前主机中可接收消息的活动会话，并隐藏空白预建行和子 agent。
dsh-bridge 的功能「按 ID 或标题发送」：使用 session_send 指定目标和消息，可选择自动、仅 ID 或仅标题匹配；重名标题会返回候选 ID 错误。
dsh-bridge 的功能「读取近期投递」：session_messages 返回发给当前会话的消息记录，调用者可设读取条数，上限由 maxMessagesPerRead 配置约束。
dsh-bridge 的功能「恢复离线会话并投递」：发送到已保存但未运行的目标时会先请求恢复，再将消息作为 follow-up 交给该会话。
dsh-bridge 的功能「集成投递接口」：其他本地代码可调用 dshBridge 服务的 deliverExternal，并传入来源、目标、消息和可选传输标识。
dsh-bridge 的使用须知：近期消息和重复 ID 记录只保存在当前进程内存中，数量受配置限制，插件重载后不会作为持久邮箱保留。
dsh-bridge README · Introduction：

dsh-bridge README · DSH Bridge：[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-bridge) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) Let sessions in one DeepSeek Harness host discover each other and exchange messages. Bridge is the local foundation beneath Chat rooms and trusted Weave delivery.

dsh-bridge README · Three tools, one local host：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `session_list` | Discover sessions and their current state. |
| `session_send` | Send by exact session ID or human-readable title. |
| `session_messages` | Read a bounded recent delivery log. |

dsh-bridge README · Quick start：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bridge@latest
dsh web
```

Ask an agent to list sessions, then send a message to the intended session. Bridge adds tools directly; it has no separate settings page.

For `session_send`, `mode: auto` tries the ID before the title; `id` and `name` select one lookup method. Titles match case-insensitively. Ambiguous names return candidate IDs instead of choosing a recipient for you.

dsh-bridge README · Delivery that respects session state：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Send[Send message] --> Resolve[Resolve target]
  Resolve --> Live[Live session]
  Resolve --> Cold[Resume persisted session]

- Idle agents wake; running agents receive queued work.
- Persisted sessions resume with their recorded preset and model.
- Concurrent requests to a cold session share one resume operation.
- Archived sessions reject delivery and are not woken.
- Cancelling during a cold resume prevents a late follow-up, even if the shared load finishes.
dsh-bridge README · Delivery that respects session state：A delivery acknowledgement means the session accepted the follow-up. It does not mean the model has processed it or completed the task.

dsh-bridge README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `recentMessages` | `1000` | Retained messages per host. |
| `dedupeCapacity` | `10000` | Remembered external message IDs. |
| `maxMessagesPerRead` | `100` | Maximum messages returned per read. |

dsh-bridge README · Plugin integration：`ctx.dshBridge` is the public service. Trusted transports call `deliverExternal()` so local and external delivery share the same follow-up and audit path. Its optional `signal` carries cancellation through session resolution.

[DSH Weave](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-weave) supplies cross-host transport; [DSH Chat](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-chat) supplies rooms and a Web conversation view. Neither is required for local messaging.

dsh-bridge README · Retention & boundaries：Bridge operates within one host process. Its recent-message log and duplicate-ID table live in memory and reset on plugin unload or reload; they are not a durable mailbox. The old `ctx.sessionMessaging` accessor remains a temporary compatibility alias.
